<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Root level comment containing markup chars <>&'" -->
  <?pi-target2 attr="value"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section with entities &ent; and tags <child/> ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % external_param SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd.ent">
  <!ENTITY local_ent "Local Value">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY bin_ext SYSTEM "binary.bin" NDATA txt>
  <?custom-pi test="1"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:ns="http://xml.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment in DTD-heavy document -->
  <?target data?>
  <section ns:role="primary">
    <![CDATA[ First CDATA block: <section>&local_ent;</section> ]]>
  </section>
  <section>
    <![CDATA[ Second CDATA block with unclosed elements: <foo> ]]&local_ent;> ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % block "<!ENTITY ent3 'ParamEntity'>">
  %block;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="extended">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block with hyphens -- and entities &ent2; -->
  <?processing-instruction test="data"?>
  <item xlink:type="locator" xlink:href="&ent3;">
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with nested structures:
      <item>Test</item>
      &ent2;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY eA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY eB "Beta &eA;">
  <!ENTITY eC "Gamma &eB;">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY eD 'Delta'>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!NOTATION jpg SYSTEM "image/jpeg">
  <!ENTITY photo SYSTEM "photo.jpg" NDATA jpg>
  <?log level="debug"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://schemas.example.com/metadata">
  <!-- Comment: Testing deep entity expansion with CDATA and multiple namespaces -->
  <?meta:action execute="true"?>
  <meta:details>
    <![CDATA[
      <archive>
        <entry>&eC;</entry>
        <entry>&eD;</entry>
      </archive>
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <entry>&eC;</entry>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock+)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Widget">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Gadget &itemA;">
  <!ENTITY % entSet "<!ENTITY itemC 'Super &itemB;'>">
  %entSet;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?xml-app-info status="active"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="urn:inventory:schema" xmlns:data="urn:inventory:data" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top comment outlining schema rules -->
  <?data:processor mode="strict"?>
  <stock data:id="S-001" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing entity references &itemC;
      and arbitrary text <stock>invalid-tag</stock>
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <stock>&itemC;</stock>
</inventory>
```
